# SESSION 82 — COMBINED HANDOFF
# Open Session 83 with `bash pack58/open58.sh` using the LOWDIN-HANDOFF-82 tar.
# NO SEALED FILE WAS EDITED. c = 137.035999 remains the only number ever entered.
# THE DERIVATION IS 107 ROWS, Z=2..108. Any claim of 119 is a boundary violation.

## §0 · OPEN
`bash pack58/open58.sh` passed: s81 seal **1354/1354 root MATCH**, canary CLEAN, STATE
CARD CLEAN. M ruled the sequence at open: **item 5, then item 4, then item 1, then 2+3.**
**ITEMS 5 AND 4 CLOSED. ITEMS 1, 2 AND 3 NOT STARTED — clause 1 is untouched and remains
the last open deliverable.** M issued **TWO RULINGS**, R82.1 and R82.2, both binding.

## §1 · ITEM 5 — R81.7 DISCHARGED. **F81.1 COST A WORD AND NOTHING ELSE.**
pack82/RESULT-S82-ITEM5-F811-PROPAGATION.md. Prediction sha 9efc9285...13c4a58d filed first.
`f811.py`, 486 .py files scanned, structural detector (re-seed + energy accumulation),
never lexical. **THE TWO CLAUSES THAT DECIDE IT BOTH RETURNED ZERO:**
**X2 one-sided termination tests = 0** tree-wide — every stationarity test reads
`abs(E2−E) < ESTAT`. On a RISING ladder a signed test would never fire or fire at pass 1,
and 7p rises; none exists. **X4 external consumers of the signed quantity = 0** — nothing
reads `drop_mHa`. **NO NUMBER ANYWHERE WAS COMPUTED FROM A MIS-SIGNED INPUT.**
**FOUR SENSES OF "LADDER", 19 FILES SAY IT, 3 MEAN IT:** S1 nlguard rung ladder · S2
nlchain restart-mode walk · **S3 restart-to-stationarity, F81.1's only object** · S4 a
radial quadrature grid in corepol, pre-s80, found by the scan.
**CORRECTED VOCABULARY, NOW LAW IN PRACTICE:** the quantity is the **RESTART OFFSET**,
SIGNED; its magnitude is a **RESOLUTION**; it is not a drop, not a descent, not a distance
to a basin floor. Demonstrated: `perturb82_vocab.py` is perturb81 with exactly the 9
flagged sites corrected, lints rc=0 where the sealed original lints rc=1.
**FORWARD GATE: `f811.py lint PATH` binds every instrument from s82 onward.**
Scored: X1 X2 X3 X4 X6 X7 correct, **X5 SPLIT** (17 sites, above my 4–12 band — I counted
code and forgot docstrings, and the docstrings are where the fault lived).
**X6 was filed as the clause I expected to lose and it held. Third session running.**

## §2 · ITEM 4 — R81.6 **NOT DISCHARGED, AND RETURNED TO M WITH THE REASON.**
pack82/RESULT-S82-ITEM4-CONVERGED-FIELD.md. Prediction sha c25baba9...9d6daf11 filed first.
`conf82.py` IMPORTS pack81/fixed81.py unmodified. Z=89 cfg88+6d converged and restarted to
stationarity (R81.2), 12 passes, E = −25694.541665071.
**A FREE DETERMINISM RECEIPT: the restart offset came back −0.034493 mHa, reproducing
F80.2's figure to six decimals in a different instrument in a different session.**
**Y1 CONTROL EXACT:** census zero = SCF's own eps(6d) = −0.176896095, **diff 0.000000 mHa**.
**THE NODE CENSUS — MONOTONE, NOTHING SKIPPED, nd CLIMBS 3 → 16.** The 4-node region spans
86 scan points and the 5-node region 66. **THE STATES ARE THERE. THE ZEROS ARE NOT.**
| ch | target nd | pts at target | zeros |
|---|---|---|---|
| 6d (control) | 3 | 372 | **1, exact** |
| 7d | 4 | **86** | **0** |
| 8d | 5 | **66** | **0** |
**ALL THREE FILED EXPLANATIONS KILLED BY MEASUREMENT.** H1 tail not −1/r: **DEAD**,
q_eff = −r·V = **1.000000** from 20 to 298 a₀. H2 grid too small: **DEAD**, r_max = **300 a₀**,
npts 4000, 6d identically zero at the edge. H3 physics terminates the ladder: **IMPOSSIBLE**,
H1 forecloses it. Scored: Y1 Y2 Y5 correct, Y6 correct in verdict/wrong in mechanism,
**Y3 and Y4 FALSIFIED — and Y4 was the clause I filed as the one with the content.**

## §3 · F82.1 AND F82.2 — TWO FAULTS, AND THEY ARE THE SAME FAULT TWICE
**F82.1 THE FAULT DETECTOR COULD NOT SEE THE FAULT. THREE DRAFTS.** Draft 1 (paren) caught
by a can-fail at rc=4. Draft 2 (claimed both operand orders, had tested one) caught by a
can-fail written to attack my own repair. **DRAFT 3 CAUGHT BY NO GATE AT ALL**: `\.P0\s*=`
cannot see a tuple-target re-seed, so perturb80 was scored as carrying no ladder while
perturb81 and fixed81 were caught INCIDENTALLY by an unrelated `.P0 = None`. **X1 read 2
instead of 3 and X4 read 1 instead of 0 — the headline wrong in both directions at once.
All five synthetic can-fails passed.** REPAIRED, and the repair is R82.1.
**F82.2 THE MATCHING CRITERION CANNOT SEE A RYDBERG CHANNEL.** f = log(nrm) crosses zero
**exactly once** in the whole l=2 channel — at 6d — and is positive and RISING at every
energy above it, +3.15 → +8.49. **Every channel shallower than the valence eigenvalue is
invisible BY CONSTRUCTION. s81's 80x widening could never have worked.** Unseen for three
sessions **because the control always passed, and the control was 6d — sited in the one
region where the instrument works.**
**SEVERITY BOUNDED AND ARGUED: no ordering, no entrant, no sealed row moves.** The hidden
channels are the LEAST bound in their ℓ; the currency is total-energy dE; a least-bound
channel cannot be an entrant at any Z. **THE FAULT HIDES EXACTLY THE STATES THAT CAN NEVER
WIN.** M's R81.6 ruling is what kept it out of the record, made before it was known.
**NINTH APPEARANCE IN FIVE SESSIONS.**

## §4 · M's TWO RULINGS — BINDING
**R82.1 · THE POSITIVE CONTROL.** Any detector that scans the corpus must include among its
can-fails at least one REAL file from the corpus whose verdict is established by inspection
and written down BEFORE the detector runs, in BOTH directions, and it GATES.
**f811 retrofitted immediately; PC1 is the very file draft 3 missed; nothing scored moved.**
**R82.2 · THE DOUBT-SITED CONTROL.** A control must be sited where the instrument is
DOUBTED, not where it is TRUSTED. Declare the domain (trusted/doubted), site a control in
the doubted region, file its expectation first, and **HALT at rc=5 if no such control can
be built — the impossibility is the finding.** A doubt-sited control MAY FAIL; that
restricts the claim rather than voiding it. **Only not looking is forbidden.**
**HARNESS `pack82/doubt82.py` BUILT AND SELF-TESTED IN FOUR DIRECTIONS, INCLUDING THE
F82.2 CASE (trusted-only → rc=5). NOT YET EXERCISED ON A PHYSICAL INSTRUMENT — s83.**

## §5 · UNCHANGED
Deliverable 1, the gates, the STATE CARD, the chain and every sealed row are untouched.
**NO PROPERTY OF F_core HAS BEEN DERIVED. CLAUSE 1 IS THE LAST OPEN DELIVERABLE AND WAS
NOT REACHED THIS SESSION.** T4 unblocked, last by practice. THE ALPHA THREAD REMAINS
CLOSED. Z=111 WITHHELD. F67.1–F67.6 remain UNVERIFIABLE. O-C1 open, floor ~0.0015 mHa.

# ORDER FOR SESSION 83 — issued at s82 close, under R82.1 and R82.2.
# Open with `bash pack58/open58.sh` using the LOWDIN-HANDOFF-82 tar.
# **ITEM 1 IS THE SESSION. EVERYTHING BELOW IT IS SECONDARY AND MAY BE HANDED ON.**

## ITEM 1 · R81.4 · CLAUSE 1. **THE LAST OPEN DELIVERABLE. IT GETS THE ROOM.**
Two sessions have now been spent on hygiene around it. **s83 OPENS ON CLAUSE 1 AND DOES
NOT LEAVE IT UNTIL THE SESSION IS SPENT OR THE ITEM IS CLOSED.**
Derive a cross-channel property of F_core. **(c) PREFERRED, (a) AND (b) RUN, comparison
decides — a preference is not a selection.**
  (a) target restated Z-SPECIFIC, proved at each Z;
  (b) any property carries a BOUND on the relaxation term;
  (c) **PREFERRED** — the property proved at the RELAXED field directly.
**THE FIXED-FIELD TARGET IS DEAD:** at Z=90 the relaxation term is 89.901 mHa against a
79.244 mHa gap. **The 10.1 mHa figure is Z=89's ONLY and must not travel.** Z=91 (where
the entrant FLIPS to 5f) is available as a third data point IF (b) or (c) needs it —
**not a standalone item.**
**AND IT IS THE ONLY ITEM HERE THAT ADVANCES THE LÖWDIN SOLUTION. The rest is upkeep.**

## ITEM 2 · R81.1 + R81.3 · THE STATIONARY CHAIN, 107 ROWS, WITH TOL BOTH WAYS.
**NO SEALED ROW IS EDITED. A SECOND CHAIN IS WRITTEN.** Sealed chain rules until the
comparison is scored. **THE SCORE IS THE ORDERING — entrant, rank 1, rank 2 — NOT the
energy.** ~0.03 mHa moves are expected and are not findings. Zeno-segmented, resumable
(F53.3), prediction hashed before row one. **Scheme-wide floor AND per-configuration
measured floor on IDENTICAL rows — M expects per-configuration and that expectation is
recorded to be SCORED AGAINST, never to pre-select.** Five measurements now exist
(6d(89) −0.0345 · 7p(89) **+0.0222** · 6d²(90) −0.0255 · 5f(90) −0.0602 · 6d(89) again
−0.034493 from conf82). **Five is still not a decision.**
**Largest computation the project has ordered. Hand off mid-chain if it does not fit.**

## ITEM 3 · R82.2's FIRST EXERCISE. **BIND doubt82 TO A REAL INSTRUMENT.**
`pack82/doubt82.py` is built and self-tested and **HAS NEVER TOUCHED A PHYSICAL
INSTRUMENT.** A harness that has only ever passed its own self-test is exactly the species
this project registers. **Its first binding is whatever instrument s83 writes** — clause 1's
included. Declare the domain, site the control in the doubted region, file the expectation.

## ITEM 4 · R81.6 — **DEFERRED BY RECOMMENDATION, M TO RULE.**
7d/8d stay **CLASS B**. The confirmation cannot be discharged by widening, re-converging or
re-branching (F82.2); it needs a different bound-state criterion — candidate, UNTESTED: match
a log-derivative at a turning point against an inward integration from r_max. Whether
`t7e_probe` can express that is unknown and unmeasured.
**THE RECOMMENDATION ON THE RECORD: NOT NEEDED FOR THE LÖWDIN SOLUTION.** The hidden
channels are the least bound in their ℓ and can never be entrants under a total-energy
currency. **ONE CAVEAT NOT CLOSED: within a given field the criterion returns ONE state per
ℓ, and whether that is a Rydberg limit or a per-field convention is unsettled.** If M rules
it worth a session, it goes AFTER clause 1, and it is the natural first client of doubt82.

## CARRIED, UNCLOSED
O-C1 (floor ~0.0015 mHa at 7p, ~0.005% of m(89)) · **F82.2 OPEN, bounded, no row disturbed** ·
F54.1 · F67.1–F67.6 UNVERIFIABLE · Rung B still not built · Deliverable 1 §6.1 (structure
only — **M ruled the Z=90 FIGURES OUT**) · T4 writing, R 1701 onward, always last.
**F81.1 IS DISCHARGED** (X2 = 0, X4 = 0). **F81.2/F81.3/F81.4 repaired at s81. F82.1
repaired at s82.**

## STANDING, CARRIED — TWO ARE NEW
* **R82.1: a corpus scanner's can-fails must include a REAL file from the corpus, both
  directions, verdict written down first, and it GATES.**
* **R82.2: a control must be sited where the instrument is DOUBTED. No doubt-sited control
  → rc=5, and the impossibility is the finding.**
* R81.2: any instrument comparing two energies restarts BOTH sides to stationarity first.
* R81.7's vocabulary: **RESTART OFFSET, signed. Its magnitude is a RESOLUTION.** Every new
  instrument is linted: `python3 pack82/f811.py lint PATH`.
* Predictions filed and hashed BEFORE runs; the driver halts on a sha mismatch.
* Can-fails run FIRST and GATE. Comparison decides; both candidates run.
* **READ THE UNITS · READ WHICH ONE IT PICKED · READ WHETHER THE INSTRUMENT CAN SEE WHAT IT
  CLAIMS · READ WHETHER A DIRECTION WAS MEASURED OR ASSUMED · READ WHAT THE PATCH ACTUALLY
  REPLACED · READ WHETHER THE TEST THAT PROVES IT CAN SEE CAME FROM THE PICTURE THAT MADE
  IT BLIND · READ WHERE THE CONTROL WAS SITED.** Nine faults in five sessions, one species.
* Seal before 90% context. Zeno-segment every run.

# SESSION 82 SEALED · HANDOFF THRESHOLD REACHED (~92%)

**Seal: `files=1375/1375 root=MATCH`, CLEAN — and fresh-extract tested** (F51.2 discipline): the tar was unpacked to a clean directory and re-verified independently. Root `a34b9174...1640261`. 2027 entries.

## WHAT CLOSED

**ITEM 5 — R81.7 discharged. F81.1 cost a word and nothing else.** The two clauses that decide it both returned zero across 486 files: no one-sided termination test exists anywhere, and nothing reads the signed quantity. Four senses of "ladder" in the corpus; nineteen files say it, three mean it. Forward lint gate installed.

**ITEM 4 — R81.6 *not* discharged, returned to you with the reason.** The control was exact to nine digits and all three of my filed explanations died by measurement: the tail *is* −1/r (q_eff = 1.000000 out to 298 a₀), the grid *is* big enough (300 a₀), so the physics *cannot* terminate the d ladder. The cause is a fourth hypothesis I did not file — **the matching criterion crosses zero exactly once per channel and rises thereafter**, making every state above valence invisible by construction. s81's 80× widening was never going to work.

**R82.1 and R82.2 entered as law**, and the harness for R82.2 is built and self-tested in four directions including the F82.2 case itself.

## WHAT I OWE YOU PLAINLY

**Clause 1 was not reached.** Two sessions have now gone to hygiene around the last open deliverable. The order for s83 opens on it and does not leave it — everything else is marked secondary and handed on.

**Two faults, and they are the same fault twice.** F82.1's third draft was caught by no gate at all — all five synthetic can-fails passed a detector that missed a third of its targets. F82.2 went unseen for three sessions because the control always passed, and the control was sited where the instrument works. Your two rulings are the repair for both, arriving from opposite directions on the same day.

**One clause I lost badly:** Y4, filed as "the clause with the content," reasoned about the grid without measuring it — in the session whose own law is that a direction must be measured, not assumed.

**Ninth fault in five sessions, one species.** None suppressed.

## FOR S83 OPEN

Open with `bash pack58/open58.sh` using the handoff tar. Two things await your ruling before work begins:

1. **Item 4's deferral.** My recommendation is on the record: the hidden channels are the least bound in their ℓ and can never be entrants under a total-energy currency, so this is **not needed for the Löwdin solution**. One caveat stays open — within a given field the criterion returns one state per ℓ, and whether that is a Rydberg limit or a per-field convention is unsettled.
2. **doubt82 has never touched a physical instrument.** A harness that has only passed its own self-test is exactly the species this project registers. Its first binding should be whatever s83 writes.
